name: jarvis-immersive
description: Deep-dives your project and builds unique, production-grade 3D / animated websites, verified in a real browser.

interface.shortDescription: Original, interactive 3D websites with real-browser quality gates.
interface.longDescription: Studies your project, finds an idea only your brand could own, builds it natively in your stack (three.js, R3F, TresJS, Threlte, GSAP) and proves it in a real browser: reduced motion, no-WebGL fallback, keyboard, context loss, vitals and a screenshot critique loop.
defaultPrompt: Deep-dive this project and build an original interactive 3D homepage.
Inspect our 3D site in a real browser and fix what would fail review.
Find CC0 HDRIs and materials for this scene.
